newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rebound in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rebound in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rebounded on early Tuesday morning after strength in the yen against the dollar knocked the indices lower on the previous day, brokers said. They added however that investors were carefully watching currencies and were mostly sidelined.
As of 0019 GMT, the Nikkei average was up 139.92 points or 0.69 percent at 20,363.74. Its June futures rose 100 to 20,370.
"Stocks fell in the previous session so some correction was expected, but the yen is still strong and noone can predict what will happen to it so gains could be hard to hang on to," one broker said.
